boundaries: Liking, comfort, truth, good, utility and prestige do not replace the judgment of beauty.
Finished work remains beautiful; incompleteness or ignorance does not certify beauty or impose a duty to continue.
Fictional scenes, general observation and named historical/scientific references retain their distinct original scope.
Prime constructed number need not be prime; historic Maxwell speeds are approximate,1865 independence from a particular model is not abandonment of ether.
Tree rings have environmental/chronological conditions; timber date does not automatically date a building; traces do not excuse harm.
Observable maintenance, differentiation and variation do not prove metaphysical irreducibility or subjecthood; no biological social/reproductive duties.
Illumination/surface and vision jointly matter, rods and cones do not change shifts by a clock; acquired expectations are not universal musical law.
Acknowledging one judgment is not assuming all causal blame or validating forced confession; purpose is not certified by obsession, pain, praise or success.
